Ravi: Quick flag: onboarding 'atlas-hybrid-13b' (llama->mistral->qwen conversion path) shows intermittent token-glue + rotated-phase drift after grouped GPTQ (q4_0) on a small corpus. Minimal repro below.

Ravi: Repro steps (short):
```bash
# convert chain: llama ckpt -> mistral-layout -> qwen-layout
python convert_chain.py --src ckpt/atlas --steps llama->mistral->qwen --out atlas.pt
python quantize.py --model atlas.pt --scheme q4_0 --out atlas.q4 --checksums
python tiny_run.py --model atlas.q4 --prompt "The river Nile flows through" --max-tokens 8 --dump-logits --dump-kv
```
Observed: occasional glued tokens like "riverNile" and doubled EOS for some prompts. Attention maps show head-specific phase offsets (head 5/7) that are inconsistent with FP16 baseline.

Tess: Can you paste a small token trace + rotary shapes pre/post quant? Also the `--checksums` output if available.

Ravi: Paste: 
```
nids: [314, 19, 88, 2]
tokens: ["The", "river", "Nile", "</s>"]
q4_out: ["The", "riverNile", "</s>"]
rotary_shape_before: [40, 64]
rotary_meta_after_quant: [2560]  # flattened
quant_checksums: rotary_tensor: crc32=0xbc9f1d2a shape_meta=(2560,)
```

Hao: That `shape_meta` looks flattened (num_heads * head_dim). We've seen grouped-quant packing accidentally lose the head axis when parameters are broadcastable before packing. Two likely causes: converter collapsed (heads,dim) -> (dim,) during transpose, or quant packer flattens a non-contiguous view.

tokenizer-bot: tokenizer-scan: found 2 duplicate byte-sequence aliases and inconsistent NFC normalization across artifacts. Suggest running `tokenizer.normalize(nfc=True)` before conversion.

Tess: Another twist: atlas was exported from a hybrid repo where some attention layers set per-head rotary frequency, others used global freq. Our packer assumes consistent layout and may have broadcasted a 1D freq across heads, then quantization fused it. Need a detection + invariant check in converter.

Ravi: Added a small local shim that rebuilds per-head inv_freq when a 1D rotary tensor is found:
```
if rotary_meta_rank == 1 and expected_shape == (num_heads, head_dim):
  inv = compute_inv_freq(head_dim, base=10000)
  rotary_rebuilt = inv.reshape(1, head_dim).repeat(num_heads, 1)
  use(rotary_rebuilt)
```
This fixed short-prompt lexicon outputs to match FP16 within token alignment tolerance. Perf hit ~ +1.8ms/token on CPU serving.

Hao: Good triage. We should add two concrete things: 1) converter shape guard that errors if rotary param shape doesn't match (num_heads, head_dim) or explicitly documents when broadcasting is allowed; 2) quant packer checksum assert to detect flattening (compare pre/post CRC and expected dims).

Ravi: I also ran `--dump-kv idx=0..2` diff vs FP16. KV for head 5 had pos offset +1 in q4 artifact. Trace snippet:
```
KV_HEAD_DUMP head=5 pos0: fp16_k=[0.12, -0.03]  q4_k=[0.03, 0.11]  # phase rotated
apply_rotary debug: head=5 pos=0 angle_idx=1 vs expected 0
```

Tess: That off-by-one in angle_idx suggests the position id pipeline may be inserting a sentinel or stripping a bos somewhere in the conversion chain. Check tokenizer output token ids alignment (pre- and post-conversion tokenizers).

tokenizer-bot: tokenizer-compare: pre-conv tokenizer normalizes to NFC, post-conv artifact had mixed normalization. Duplicate byte sequences at indices [1021, 1876] map to similar grapheme clusters. Recommendation: fail conversion if duplicate byte-seq detected and provide remediation.

Hao: For quant experiments: try q3_k and q5_0 on a small shard and capture `--param-layout` diffs. If group size changes preserve the original tensor strides, we may prefer a safer default until converter fix. Also log rot_freq checksum before pack and assert equality after unpack.

Ravi: I spun q3_k on a 1% shard overnight. Preliminary: q3_k artifacts preserved rotary shape metadata (shape meta [40,64]) and lexicon smoke reduced fails to 2/420 vs 9/420 for q4_0. I'll upload results.

ci-bot: quant-job #9823 completed for atlas-hybrid-13b (q3_k). artifact: s3://redwood-quant/atlas-hybrid/9823/atlas.q3k checksum rotary=0x9a7b3f4d

Ravi: Created WIP PR with runtime rebuild fallback and a synthetic test `tests/rotary_sinc_sanity.py` that checks phase alignment across head dims. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/10321 (WIP). Contains a tokenizer-normalize gate and a checksum assert in quant packer.

Tess: Nice. For immediate onboarding policy: fail conversion on duplicate byte-seq or mismatched rotary shape; recommend q3_k as a temporary quant scheme for affected families. Also add an eval-suite test that runs lexicon smoke + random diacritic probes.

Hao: I'll add a small quant-packer unit test that intentionally uses a (heads,dim) non-contiguous view to make sure packing preserves shape. Also implement a lightweight runtime log when fallback triggers so we can triage frequency across customers.

eval-bot: regression-suite/lexicon-smoke for atlas-hybrid (q3_k) run complete  2/420 failing. Report: https://internal/reports/8201010101

Ravi: Assigning follow-ups: Ravi (PR + regen artifacts), Tess (converter enforcement + eval-suite), Hao (quant packer tests + param checksum asserts). I'll notify oncall if we see any public endpoints using atlas-hybrid.

Tess: I'll add a short KB entry in onboarding docs about rotary-per-head vs global freq and how to catch it during conversion.

Ravi: Thanks team  will update PR and post artifact links when CI finishes. :coffee:
